title: Totally real cubic getfu leaf
objective: Translate and qualify the smallest totally-real-cubic PARI 2.17.4 getfu suffix from prepared sign-free clean unit logs through real rank-two LLL, exponentiation, 3x3 real solve, rounding, exact unit/inverse authentication, inverse normalization and matched not_given status.

oracles: Pinned pristine PARI 2.17.4 stage-local getfu wrapper

handoff.summary: Added a source-transparent prepared getfu leaf for sign-free totally real cubic logs: fixarch, rank-two fast/DPE LLL, packed-real exponentiation, source-order 3x3 solve and rounding, then exact cubic-unit determinant/inverse/product authentication and norm normalization. A source-hashed pristine PARI 2.17.4 oracle supplies 16 stage-local cases over four totally real cubics. Four reconstruct successfully, eight stop with fupb_PRECI and four with fupb_LARGE; all statuses match PARI and successful CPython/JavaScript/GMP outputs agree exactly. The checker independently proves both returned columns have determinant plus or minus one, verifies each exact inverse product is one, checks smallest-coordinate-norm normalization, and checks a unimodular rank-two log transform. The broad test:changed command completed pnpm build successfully in 12 minutes, then was intentionally stopped during architecture checks for concurrent resource coordination; the focused recorded checker passes.
risks: The leaf accepts sign-free real logs only. The oracle doubles genuine log-unit columns so all-real sign phases exponentiate trivially; characteristic-two sign recovery remains outside this claim.

PARI and the translated fast/DPE LLL may choose different unimodular bases. The oracle therefore compares stop semantics and exact unit validity while CPython, JavaScript and GMP must agree on the translated basis.
Mixed complex signatures, relation-to-unit lattice extraction, public result construction and integration-driver wiring remain out of scope.
The connected native core is about 12.8 MB and should be deduplicated or linked into a larger private call graph by the integration lane rather than exposed as a separate production artifact.
next_steps: Wire the clean sign-free totally-real cubic log packet and nf embedding/multiplication tensor into this leaf after relation/HNF extraction.
Add the characteristic-two sign-phase path before claiming arbitrary totally-real cubic fundamental units.
Generalize the solve and exact multiplication owner shapes only after the cubic integration is replayed end to end.
